shortDescription: The CAC 40 Index dropped 50 points or 0.60 percent on Monday to close at 8351 points.Losses were led by Airbus (-2.86%), Safran (-2.30%) and STMicroelectronics (-2.06%).Offsetting the fall, top gainers were Stellantis NV (1.83%), Pernod Ricard (1.80%) and TotalEnergies SE (1.40%).

children: The CAC 40 Index dropped 50 points or 0.60 percent on Monday to close at 8351 points.
Losses were led by Airbus (-2.86%), Safran (-2.30%) and STMicroelectronics (-2.06%).
Offsetting the fall, top gainers were Stellantis NV (1.83%), Pernod Ricard (1.80%) and TotalEnergies SE (1.40%).

title: The CAC 40 Index Closes 0.60% Lower
